title: Remi Collection 30-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar in Solid Brass | Allied Brass
body_html:
Organize your bathroom with the sculptural elegance of the Remi Collection towel bar. This 30-inch fixture blends modern and traditional aesthetics, featuring a unique curved accent that makes a sophisticated statement in any bathroom.

  • Durable Construction: Crafted from the finest solid brass for enduring quality and rust-free performance.
  • Sleek Installation: Features concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, architectural appearance.
  • Versatile Style: Part of the coordinated Remi collection, designed to match contemporary or minimalist decor.
  • Finish Variety: Choose from 25 designer finishes to perfectly complement your existing hardware.

Specifications:
Width: 30-Inch
Diameter: 0.75-Inch
Material: Solid Brass
Projection: 3.37-Inch
Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and installation hardware
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Remi Collection 30 Inch Towel Bar
_previous.description: This Remi collection Towel Bar from Allied Brass is nothing short of modern meets traditional. The curved accent with an upright style makes this accessory unique and trend setting at the same time. Made from high quality metal and finished in a lifetime designer finish, this beautiful towel bar is extremely attractive yet highly functional. Whether your bath décor features traditional Old World styling or a cleaner, more contemporary design, the Remi Collection has bath accessories to meet your design and decorating needs. All of the Remi Collection products come with a limited lifetime warranty.
